The Hazir Loop

Catch → Train → Launch → Compound

1

Every inbound signal — call, chat, text, DM, form — is captured in under a second, 24/7. Nothing slips to voicemail or an ignored inbox. Your HazirMinds team greets each person by name, answers their question, and asks the two or three questions that qualify them for your business.

2

We train your agents on your services, pricing, FAQs, tone and boundaries before a single customer hears them. Scripts are approved by you, knowledge comes from your documents and site, and edge cases get explicit rules — so the agent works only from your approved material.

3

Go-live is supervised: real traffic, weekly tuning, and a human review of every transcript in week one. You see exactly what callers asked and how the AI answered. Adjustments ship in days — voice, scripts, routing, escalation thresholds.

4

The loop compounds: transcripts feed better scripts, better scripts lift conversion, analytics surface new automations, and monthly reviews add capabilities. Your AI team gets measurably better every month it runs — that’s the Hazir Loop.

“Hazir” — present, ready, attentive. It's what your AI team always is. It's also the name of our flagship plan.
